evidence_tier: static ROM-derived evidence (decoded sites, recursive descent, executed lemmas on a fail-closed interpreter) plus controlled execution of the original Z80 code in the DECOMP harness; not an emulator run of the console, not hardware
premises: P1 Standard Sega mapper semantics (DECOMP-1D R4). Slot 0 is bank 0 (R2 census); slot 1 is bank 1 whenever resident code reads $4000-$7FFF (DECOMP-1D R3); slot 2 is whatever the instruction sequence last wrote through $1C6F, derived below, never assumed.

P2 A bank register value is taken modulo the number of 16 KB banks of the image (32): the address lines of a 512 KB cartridge. R2 never needed this; R3 does, because a garbage header byte can name a bank above 31.
P3 An interrupt that fires while a derived mapper state is in force restores it (the IM 1 handler saves and restores slot 2 through the $D12B shadow; DECOMP-1D R1 interrupt model).

P4 Controlled execution is the DECOMP harness (z80 core, Sega mapper, approximate VDP): the original code with zeroed power-on RAM. It is not an emulator of the console and not hardware validation. The stage entry is forced (the stores $178F makes after its guards), so a run says what the code does once the state exists, never that the state can occur.

P5 The sweep accelerates the special-stage timer (D2BF := 0 sixty frames after the stage is active) so the timer's own timeout branch runs. Acceleration changes what garbage handlers can do over 59 seconds, so every row whose accelerated run returned is run again with the natural timer, the threshold cases are run both ways, and a PROVEN RETURNABLE verdict needs both runs to return.
P6 Player inputs, 100-ring collection (U6) and the emerald masks (U2) are adversarial/free: a route that needs them is 'conditional' on them and is never reported as grounded.

R3 resolved the loader, the header table ($4FDC), the placement table ($8000 in bank $1C) and the music table; the graphics table at $7CED, the start-position table at $4E98 and the palette routine were not analysed. Every out-of-domain stage depends on all of them at once.

A slot type or object type outside its table (slot types $15-$7F/$95-$FF, object types $64-$EF) dispatches through bytes that are not table data; destinations that are RAM addresses make the next instructions RAM-determined.

The sweep forces D2BF := 0 (P5), and the harness zero-fills RAM at power-on; the contents real hardware has there are not defined by the ROM, so every RAM-dependent run (jumps into RAM, reads of RAM pointers) is a statement about the harness state only.
Emerald masks are object-supplied ($794A7, $7BB69); a special-stage zone above 8 needs bits 0..3 set. Every route to zones 9..12 is reported conditional on them.
